C1.worst_defect: The hero says what it is ('Point of sale for Vendure', 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0') but nowhere says what the hosted till at app.vendurepos.com costs or who runs it, so a shop owner cannot tell at a glance whether using it is free.

C2.worst_defect: The fact that matters most to a counter with a tablet, 'tablets and phones, an iPad included, are not tested yet', is buried mid-sentence in the 'Before you start' bullet about browsers instead of being stated as a plain limit.

C3.worst_defect: On your own store a refund cannot be done at the till: 'refund in the Vendure Dashboard. The refund stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup', and the till role 'vendurepos-pos-till' lacks ReadOrder so it must be added by hand, so tomorrow's first return needs the freelancer.
C3.where: home.desktop.02 'Live demo or your own store' table, row 'Refund a sale at the till'; at-the-till.desktop.02 'Refund a sale'; quick-start device-key step

C4.worst_defect: At the till, the page staff will actually read, opens with a plugin error ('This store's VendurePOS plugin is missing or out of date…') before any how-to, and the troubleshooting 'Till updates line' entry is a dense wall of error codes.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' mixes two bordered cards ('Keeps selling offline', 'Every sale lands once') with eight unboxed two-column items, so the section looks uneven; the cashier-sheet screenshot sits small inside a large empty grey frame.

C6.worst_defect: The 'Keeps selling offline' card becomes a long, dense paragraph on a 390 px screen, and the phone header shows only Docs and Live demo, hiding Quick start and At the till behind the menu.

C7.worst_defect: Minor only: the 404 page has no JSON-LD and the quick-start mobile LCP is 2.6 s; everything else (titles, descriptions, og-image, llms.txt, search API, sitemap, robots) is in place.

overall_worst.defect: For an owner's own store, the site says a refund 'stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup' and points to a developer page, so there is no procedure the owner or staff can follow for a return without calling the freelancer.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 table row 'Refund a sale at the till'; at-the-till 'Refund a sale'
overall_worst.fix: Add a short who-does-what box to at-the-till 'Refund a sale' (cashier: Pay out cash or refund on the terminal; manager: refund in the Dashboard and run this copy-paste settle step), and link the home table row to that box instead of Plugin setup.
